analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (53,180 KRW) below SMA5 (54,943 KRW) and SMA20 (63,899 KRW): diagnosing short-to-medium term trend in a weak position.
· Significantly below SMA100 (104,127 KRW) and SMA200 (112,736 KRW): indicating strong mid-to-long term downtrend.
· 52-week position (7.2%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (38.6→34.4): entering oversold territory, downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-8529.8043→-8529.8043): holding steady, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band at 46,545 KRW) + band width at 54.32% level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level (51,065 KRW) + based on 20-day low.
· Swing resistance level (80,380 KRW) + potential for mid-term trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.37x): low confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): conditions for entry: RSI recovery above 50 with accompanying volume.
